baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual joins تداركه at word 3 to نعمة at 4, then to نبذ at 7, العراء at 8, and مذموم at 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bestowed good catches up to the focus figure before a throwing-away process reaches exposed ground; blame belongs to the prevented endpoint rather than merely decorating the rescue.

activation_trace.role: The reaching-and-catching-up image makes favor an arriving interrupter that beats casting to its endpoint.
Bestowed well-being supplies the beneficial force that arrives rather than a quality the figure already owns.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordly favor corrective care, not an arbitrary interruption.
Casting away supplies the rejected trajectory that the arriving favor prevents.
Open ground without cover turns the threatened result into exposure, not mere relocation.
Dispraise and blame give the exposed endpoint a social and evaluative condition.

changed_reading.before: A favor simply cancels a punishment.
changed_reading.after: Favor is an arrival that overtakes the figure in time and prevents casting-away from becoming exposed, blame-bearing status.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تداركه and ربه can be heard through consequence, recourse, and repair while نبذ and مذموم retain a real adverse outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: The favor acts like recourse against a consequence already following the figure: lordly repair blocks disposal without requiring the line itself to say that no fault or liability ever existed.

activation_trace.role: The subsequent-liability or warranty image makes the thing that catches up a consequence against which recourse can operate.
Bestowed favor supplies the remedial benefit rather than a declaration of prior innocence.
Repair and stagewise care assign the Lord the role of correcting the threatened consequence.
Throwing away is the dispositive act that recourse stops.
Blame keeps fault or adverse evaluation live instead of letting rescue collapse into exoneration.

changed_reading.before: Being saved proves that the figure was never blameworthy.
changed_reading.after: The favor is remedial recourse: it prevents disposal and opens repair, while innocence, fault, and final evaluation remain distinct questions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The attainment range of تداركه, the added motion in نعمة, and both mapped inventories of ربه converge on growth before threatened discard.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rather than only arriving at the last instant, favor carries an incompletely formed subject further through nurture and maturation so that exposure does not become premature disposal.

activation_trace.role: Reaching and attaining, with maturation in the branch scope, turn catching-up into arrival at a needed developmental threshold.
Adding and carrying an action further makes favor the increment that continues an unfinished process.
Repair, nurture, and completion provide the dominant mapped root's developmental mechanism.
The non-dominant mapped root's nurture-and-growing-up image independently reinforces development rather than mere ownership.
Casting away supplies the danger of terminating development before completion.
Being stripped of normal covering renders the threatened disposal premature and unprotected.

changed_reading.before: A finished subject receives an external last-minute rescue.
changed_reading.after: Favor is also a formative continuation that brings an unfinished subject through a threatened point of premature abandonment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نبذ, العراء, and مذموم can jointly describe repudiation, stripped cover, and loss of protected standing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The threatened casting is social and quasi-legal as well as spatial: open repudiation removes covenantal cover and leaves the figure publicly exposed to blame.

activation_trace.role: Repudiating a pact openly turns casting into declared separation from a protected relation.
Stripping clothing or cover supplies the deprotection effected by public repudiation.
Covenant-protection makes blame's root also name the social cover whose loss would expose the figure.
The covenant or protection-pact image gives lordly favor a relation-preserving function.

changed_reading.before: The figure would have landed in an empty physical place.
changed_reading.after: The figure would have been openly repudiated and stripped of protected standing; favor preserves relation as well as bodily safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact favor-from-your-Lord phrase first blocks a madness label, while the closing scene joins a hostile gaze, near-dislocation, and the same label. The focus casting therefore becomes one instance of a larger contest over whether a person can be displaced into a discrediting public identity.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor is the focus-side protection whose repeated phrasing activates the frame.
Casting away supplies the focus figure's threatened displacement.
Blame links physical displacement to an imposed public evaluation.
The same bestowed-favor branch appears in the matching opening phrase and explicitly opposes discredit.
Repairing and nurturing lordship gives the repeated phrase a restorative rather than merely possessive force.
The covering-of-reason image supplies the madness label that favor directly counters in the opening.
Slipping a thing from its station turns the hostile gaze into a second threatened displacement.
Literal eyesight identifies the instrument by which the closing displacement is attempted.
Spoken utterance makes the discrediting identity a publicly voiced assignment.
The repeated reason-covering label closes the same evaluative frame opened at 68:2.

structural_cues: The normalized phrase نعمة ربك in 68:2 recurs as نعمة من ربه in the focus with only person and preposition adjusted.
The madness label occurs at both 68:2 and 68:51, bracketing the focus's threatened casting and blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies phrase repetition, a repeated madness label, hostile sight, and slipping from station; I infer that these scenes analogically frame the focus as preservation from imposed discredit. A purely physical rescue with no identity-level link remains live.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an isolated rescue of another figure from physical expulsion.
changed_reading.after: It also mirrors the surrounding protection of persons from being bodily dislodged and then fixed under a discrediting label.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence attempts to stop good from entering circulation, cuts the crop, reaches deprivation, and produces mutual blame before renewed desire for lordly replacement. In the focus, favor does the opposite: it reaches its recipient and interrupts cutting-off and disposal.

activation_trace.role: Catching up makes the focus favor successfully reach where the garden owners tried to prevent benefit from reaching.
Bestowed benefaction supplies the good whose circulation contrasts with withholding.
Casting away is the terminal exclusion prevented when benefit reaches its object.
Holding the hand back from giving establishes withholding as an opposed flow mechanism.
Useful good names what is blocked, linking the social vice to the focus's arriving benefaction.
Cutting and separation turn the planned harvest into a material model of interrupting circulation.
Entry into an interior supplies the access the owners explicitly plan to deny.
Deprivation and failure to attain the desired thing reverse the owners' attempted deprivation onto them.
Mutual reproach supplies the narrative's realized blame state, parallel to the focus's prevented blame-bearing endpoint.
One thing standing in place of another supplies a route from deprivation toward restored provision.
Repairing lordship makes hoped-for replacement restorative after the failed economy of withholding.

structural_cues: The garden narrative moves in order from intended exclusion and cutting to deprivation, self-recognition, mutual blame, and hope for replacement.
The focus reverses that sequence compactly: benefaction reaches before casting, exposure, and blame can occur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked giving, cutting, denied entry, deprivation, blame, and hoped-for replacement; I infer a causal circulation model in which favor's successful arrival counters withholding. The garden can still function as a separate moral example rather than a direct template for the focus.

changed_reading.before: The favor is a private exception granted to one endangered figure.
changed_reading.after: The favor enacts an anti-withholding economy: good reaches its object, interrupts exclusion, and keeps deprivation from ending in blame and disposal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby judgment scene unveils, lowers bodies and eyes, and has humiliation catch up to people. Against that sequence, the focus stages a rival arrival: favor catches the figure first, before exposure and blame can overtake him.

activation_trace.role: Catching up supplies one of the two competing arrivals.
Bestowed favor identifies the beneficial arrival that wins the race.
Stripping away cover makes the focus endpoint analogous to the preceding unveiling.
Blame is the evaluative counterpart of the neighboring humiliation.
Lifting a cover supplies the exposure process immediately before the focus.
Lowering and abasement establish the bodily posture associated with the exposure scene.
Drawing near and catching up makes humiliation the rival thing that can reach a person.
Brokenness under coercion specifies the adverse condition carried by the rival arrival.
Eyesight localized in lowered eyes makes shame publicly embodied rather than abstract.

structural_cues: 68:42-43 immediately precede the patience and fish-companion sequence and repeatedly coordinate exposure, lowered posture, and humiliation.
The focus's تداركه and 68:43's ترهقهم are different roots but both predicate something reaching and covering a person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unveiling, humiliation that nears and catches, and favor that catches; I infer a race in which the first arrival determines final posture. The scenes may instead be adjacent contrasts without a shared temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Favor wins a race against exposure and humiliation, so the focus turns on which condition reaches and covers the person first.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking, extended time, firm duration, patience, and corrective restraint make the focus catch-up one temporal operation within governance. Delay is not itself favor: it can carry someone toward an endpoint, while favor arrives in time to divert another trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Reaching and catching up make the rescue legible as timed interception.
Stagewise nurture places the timing under corrective lordly administration.
Taking degree by degree supplies a contrasting trajectory whose endpoint is approached incrementally.
Extended time shows that an interval can be deliberately granted without yet revealing its outcome.
Extended solidity makes the governing process durable enough to outlast premature judgments about delay.
Holding the self from panic supplies the human posture required while timing remains unresolved.
Restraint and redirection for repair make the awaited judgment corrective rather than a bare sentence.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 foreground an unseen stepwise process and deliberate extension immediately before the command to wait for lordly judgment.
The focus counterfactual depends on relative timing: favor catches before casting is realized.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stepwise progression, extended time, patience, corrective restraint, and catch-up; I infer that they are alternative uses of governed time. The delay passages can remain solely about another group and need not define the focus rescue.

changed_reading.before: The rescue is a spontaneous exception outside the surrounding rule.
changed_reading.after: The rescue is a precisely timed diversion within governance, contrasted with delay that steadily carries others toward an unrevealed endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate three-ayah sequence moves from blocked interior pressure and a voiced call, through threatened violent exteriorization onto open ground, to gathering, selection, state-change, and suitability. Favor regulates a dangerous transition between confinement and exposure rather than merely deleting an outcome.

activation_trace.role: Casting away supplies the violent outward transfer at the center of the sequence.
Open uncovered ground is the unregulated exterior into which the figure could be expelled.
Repairing lordship assigns favor the role of regulating the transition toward a viable state.
A passage sealed after filling supplies the image of dangerous interior pressure before the focus expulsion.
Raising the voice gives the blocked interior a communicative outlet immediately before the threatened cast.
Gathering and collecting reverse the focus's throwing-away motion.
Selection and drawing near turn regathering into restored proximity, not mere collection.
Causing a thing to become a state supplies the transformation after regathering.
Suitability for a thing identifies the viable condition produced after the dangerous transition.
The non-dominant nurture-and-growing branch makes the final suitability a cultivated outcome.

structural_cues: The focus is physically enclosed by 68:48 and 68:50, producing an ordered pressure, exposure, regathering sequence.
Passive threatened casting in 68:49 is answered by active lordly gathering and making in 68:50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sealed-full image, calling, casting, open ground, gathering, selection, and making suitable; I infer a pressure-and-transfer mechanism across the immediate sequence. A simpler moral sequence of error, rescue, and election remains equally live.

changed_reading.before: Favor merely prevents the figure from being thrown outside.
changed_reading.after: Favor manages passage from blocked interiority through threatened overexposure into regathered, cultivated fitness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners move from misplacement and mutual blame through admission of boundary-crossing to hope for replacement; immediately after the focus, the endangered figure is made into a suitable state. Blame is therefore serious but processual, not an immutable essence.

activation_trace.role: Blame supplies the adverse status whose duration and reversibility the context tests.
Bestowed favor provides the intervention through which the adverse status need not become terminal.
Putting a thing outside its proper place makes wrongdoing a correctable disorder rather than a substance.
Mutual reproach displays blame as an enacted social process.
Crossing the limit specifies the conduct diagnosed by blame.
Replacement makes movement out of a failed condition imaginable.
Causing a new state makes the post-focus evaluation explicitly transformational.
Soundness opposed to corruption names the state that can follow the threatened blame state.

structural_cues: The garden owners' self-accusation is followed by desire for replacement rather than narrative closure at blame.
The focus's unrealized مذموم is followed immediately by a causative making into the صالحين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confession, blame, boundary crossing, replacement, and causative state-change; I infer that blame diagnoses a trajectory that favor can interrupt and repair. It remains possible that the final صالح status is selection after blame rather than transformation of blame.

changed_reading.before: Blameworthy is the figure's fixed identity, and favor merely shields that identity from punishment.
changed_reading.after: Blame names a real but nonterminal trajectory; favor prevents its public fixation and enables a made transition toward soundness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing, false stories, demanded books, study, judgment, hidden knowledge, and further writing repeatedly contest who can inscribe a binding account. The focus blame can therefore be heard as an attribution at risk of becoming dispositive, not as an unexamined insult or an automatically final record.

activation_trace.role: Dispraise supplies the evaluative statement whose authority and finality the writing frame interrogates.
Liability or recourse makes an adverse evaluation potentially consequential without making it irreversible.
The sharpened writing implement introduces inscription as the medium of durable accounts.
Ordered written lines supply the image of claims fixed into a record.
False stories show that inscription-like claims can be dismissive misattributions rather than truth.
Judgment between people raises the question of who may turn an account into a verdict.
An inscription that establishes a binding ruling supplies the missing authority demanded by the rhetorical question.
Following a book through reading and study tests whether a claimed judgment has textual warrant.
What is hidden from eyes marks the inaccessible basis the claimants would need to possess.
Writing letters into a text turns the claimed hidden knowledge into a supposed record.

structural_cues: The branchless ك ي ف at 68:36 is used only as the text-level question 'how do you judge'; no branch citation is invented for it.
The sequence moves from pen and inscription to false stories, then asks for a studied book and challenges writing from possession of the hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing inscriptions, judgment, study, and hidden knowledge; I infer that focus blame participates in a contest over authoritative attribution. The focus adjective may still be an unqualified narrator-level evaluation rather than a disputed record.

changed_reading.before: Blameworthy is a simple, self-authenticating verdict.
changed_reading.after: Blame is an adverse attribution whose power depends on whether it has authoritative warrant and whether favor lets it harden into a dispositive record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding questions assemble binding oaths, an endpoint-reaching commitment, judgment, a guarantor, financial liability, and burden. Those branches activate the focus inventory's warranty, pact-repudiation, binding throw-sale, covenant-protection, and promise images as a coherent recourse model.

activation_trace.role: A subsequent warranty claim makes what catches up a liability for which recourse is needed.
Open repudiation of a pact supplies the adverse relational act that favor prevents.
A sale made binding by throwing turns the threatened cast into an image of dispositive transfer.
Covenant-protection supplies the protected standing that a superior guarantee can preserve.
A binding covenant or protection agreement makes lordly relation the source of recourse.
Affirmation and promise let favor function as the effective yes that counters repudiation.
The oath branch supplies the supposedly binding undertaking tested by the passage.
Reaching an endpoint makes the alleged oath's duration and enforceability explicit.
Judgment supplies the dispositive result the alleged undertaking would authorize.
Bearing a guarantee directly activates a surety role in the focus recourse model.
An adhering financial liability supplies the charge from which recourse would be sought.
Burdening with a load turns liability into a weight borne by the obligated party.

structural_cues: 68:39-41 form a compact interrogation about binding undertakings, judgment, guarantee, and partners.
68:46 adds a hypothetical charge and the bodily image of being burdened by it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a legal-economic network and the focus branches supply warranty, pact, transfer, and protection; I infer that lordly favor acts as superior recourse before a disposal becomes binding. The legal network may be local rhetoric with no intended transfer to the focus event.

changed_reading.before: Favor is only an affective mercy that suspends punishment.
changed_reading.after: Favor can also be modeled as superior recourse or guarantee that prevents repudiation and dispositive transfer while leaving the underlying liability question visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier text-level marking action targets the nose, while the focus blame root has a branch for a heat- or dust-caused facial eruption. Together with stripped open exposure, blame becomes imaginable as a publicly legible stigma on the exposed body.

activation_trace.role: A skin eruption on nose or face gives blame an odd but anchored visible-mark image.
Stripped covering makes the stigmatized surface publicly visible.
Casting away supplies the social disposal that a visible stigma could authorize.
The literal nose locates the context's marking action on the same bodily surface activated by the focus branch.

structural_cues: The branchless و س م occurrence at 68:16 word 1 supplies only the text-level act of marking and is intentionally not given a branch citation.
The mark is placed on the خرطوم, for which a branch-backed nose citation is available.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a marking action on the nose, a nose branch, and a focus branch for a facial eruption; I infer an analogy between moral blame and visible stigma. The ordinary moral sense of مذموم remains primary, and no lexical identity between marking and blame is claimed.

changed_reading.before: Blameworthy describes an inward or verbal moral evaluation only.
changed_reading.after: The prevented endpoint can also be pictured as public stigmatization: cast into exposure with blame made legible on the body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines remote foundling, foster-child, rope-link, and covenant branches rather than the ordinary surfaces. It remains anchored in every focus term's own inventory and coherently reverses abandonment into care. Downstream prose should present it only as a relational material analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The chain تداركه نعمة من ربه ... نبذ بالعراء ... مذموم supports an attached caregiver reaching an otherwise cast-off and unsupported figure.

activation_trace.role: The cast-off foundling supplies the endangered figure's relational image of abandonment.
The fostered child and caregiver relation turns lordship into taking responsibility for one cast off.
A rope link or fastening loop pictures favor as reattachment before loss.
Leaving something unsupported supplies the condition from which fosterage retrieves the figure.
Covenant-protection gives reattachment a durable protected relation rather than a momentary pickup.

changed_reading.before: A condemned individual is spared an impersonal disposal.
changed_reading.after: An otherwise cast-off, unsupported figure is overtaken, reattached, and taken back under formative and covenantal care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates soft wind, low cloud, scant water, and rain-cessation images around ordinary favor and lordship. It remains spatially anchored in the focus contrast between favor and open uncovered ground and is sharpened by the covered-garden sequence. Render it as an ecological shelter analogy, never as a claim that نعمة literally means weather here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نعمة من ربه stands between the figure and العراء, allowing favor to function analogically as shelter and sustaining moisture against exposure.

activation_trace.role: The soft moist south-wind image gives benefaction a sustaining environmental texture.
A low layered cloud that nurtures plants supplies lordly cover and moisture.
Open ground without cover is the ecological exposure opposed by wind and cloud.
A scant-water well makes the threatened condition one of failed sustenance as well as blame.
The tree-covered garden supplies the protected fertile state opposed to open ground.
An encompassing flood-like image supplies the environmental force that surrounds and transforms the garden.
Cutting and separation convert the covered productive place toward barren disconnection.
Cessation of milk or rain supplies the desiccation mechanism latent in deprivation.
Failure to attain the desired provision names the resulting deprivation.

changed_reading.before: Open ground is only the coordinates of a punishment.
changed_reading.after: Open ground is the loss of a sustaining microclimate, while favor is analogically the shelter and moisture that keep exposure from becoming deprivation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ostrich activation is conspicuously remote from the grammatical sense of نعمة, and the context's male-ostrich and chick branches are likewise non-surface images. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventories independently join ostrich-flight to scattering, casting to a scattered remnant, and العراء to open ground. Render only the functional cohesion-versus-scattering analogy, never 'ostrich' as the verse's lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places نعمة against نبذ and العراء, permitting the root's ostrich-flight idiom for rout to activate a threatened scattering into exposed remnants.

activation_trace.role: The ostrich-flight idiom literally contributes departure, rout, and loss of cohesion to the threatened counterfactual.
A small scattered remnant supplies the result when cohesion is lost.
Open uncovered ground provides the spatial field across which scattering occurs.
The male-ostrich branch creates a faint context echo near collective confession and regrouping.
The ostrich-chick branch places a second faint echo directly after the focus, where the figure is restored to a group.

changed_reading.before: One body is saved from being thrown onto open ground.
changed_reading.after: Favor also resists rout and loss of cohesion, keeping the endangered figure from becoming an exposed, scattered remnant and restoring group belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material construction built from trimming, cutting, separated pieces, slipping, and a rope-link branch. It remains anchored in the focus's own link, casting, and unsupported images and gains sequence support across the packet. Downstream prose should call it a splice metaphor for restored continuity, not a lexical derivation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rope-link branch of تداركه can oppose the severing motion implicit in نبذ and unsupported العراء.

activation_trace.role: A rope piece joined to another cord supplies the splice that restores continuity.
Casting away supplies the severed trajectory that the splice arrests.
Leaving something unsupported gives severance its terminal condition.
Cutting and trimming a hard object introduces controlled severance at the packet's opening.
Cutting and separation make severance an explicit narrative operation.
Cutting and harvesting transfer the severance image into the evaluative contrast near the focus.
A detached piece supplies the material result of severance.
Slipping from one's station supplies a final loss of attachment after the focus.

changed_reading.before: Favor reaches an already discrete individual from outside.
changed_reading.after: Favor acts like a splice in a sequence of cuts, reconnecting a trajectory before the figure becomes a detached, unsupported piece.

strongest_changes: Favor becomes the winning arrival in a contest with exposure and humiliation, not merely a static possession.
The garden sequence recasts favor as successful circulation of good against withholding, cutting, deprivation, and blame.
The immediate 68:48-50 sequence turns rescue into regulated movement from pressure through threatened exposure to regathered fitness.
Blame remains real but becomes a reversible trajectory or status rather than an immutable identity.
summary.what_was_special: Exact phrase repetition, rival catch-up verbs, the split ر ب ب mapping, and branch networks for writing, guarantee, bodily marking, weather, ostrich-scattering, and rope-splicing generated several coexisting readings. The branchless marking and judgment cues were retained only structurally, while odd branch-backed mechanisms remained explicitly contained rather than discarded.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus grammar does not settle whether favor removes blame, prevents its public realization, or repairs a blame-bearing subject.
The opening and closing madness frame may analogically govern the focus, but the physical rescue can remain independent.
Legal, ecological, ostrich, stigma, and splice models are coherent branch activations but should not be promoted into lexical translations.
The developmental contribution of non-dominant mapped ر ب ب remains exploratory even though the next ayah's gathering and making strengthen it.
